draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.65, the 246th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 32nd of 36 at CB. He went 181st overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (246th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 7 passes defended in 2022, 15th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers (reserve / out). 47 career games and 3 starts over 3 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2024. Weak spots: season snap share 0.0% (1st percentile), passes defended 0 (8th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 0.0% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, below the norm.
